title: Morocco's Round of 16 World Cup Fixture Confirmed — Date, Opponent and Kickoff
body:
Morocco have confirmed their Round of 16 fixture at the 2026 FIFA World Cup after finishing top of their group with a 3-0 victory over Haiti. The Atlas Lions, ranked 5th globally by FIFA, will face the Group E runners-up in what promises to be a historic knockout encounter.

Fan Travel from Marrakech

Royal Air Maroc has added additional flights to New York JFK and Miami for the knockout stages. Marrakech is preparing large-scale public screenings at Jemaa el-Fna and Arset El Bilk park, capable of hosting up to 8,000 fans per venue.

Source: FIFA official communications and Moroccan Football Federation.
